title: specht facts
description: The document specht facts writes for --json (0132-F2): what the specification tree holds, with no violation, count or verdict. Within a tool major version it changes only by addition (C-3).

specifications.description: Every Feature specification the check discovers, in discovery order; epic files are not given.

path.description: Relative to the root the tool was given, with / separators; never absolute.

id.description: The qualified Feature id the check reads, such as 0132-F2, or null when the specification has no identity.

specStatus.description: The specification's maturity, read through the manifest's frontmatter key, or null.

status.description: The delivery status, read through the manifest's frontmatter key, or null.

dependsOn.description: The depends-on list as the frontmatter writes it, unresolved; empty when absent.

blocks.description: The blocks list as the frontmatter writes it, unresolved; empty when absent.

children.description: The children list as the frontmatter writes it; empty when absent.
